frontmatter.name: concept-film-screenplay
frontmatter.description: Produces a concept short film screenplay through one of two paths: What-If premise (counter-intuitive premise -> consequence + payoff) or How-to-Tell form (known content reframed by an unexpected narrative device). Recommended <= 3 minutes, no hard cap. Runs autonomously: the agent decides from its persona + creative brief, no human in the loop. Three agent-self-checked promoted markdown artifacts: concept / outline / script. Skill ends after script is promoted.
